consequence.statement: DestinationRules on the same host with totally different exportTo values are no longer merged, so effective traffic policy may differ from before.
consequence.remediation: Set ENABLE_ENHANCED_DESTINATIONRULE_MERGE to false in the pilot deployment to restore the previous merging.

assertion.statement: Istio pilot no longer merges DestinationRules for the same host when their exportTo attributes are totally different; setting ENABLE_ENHANCED_DESTINATIONRULE_MERGE=false in the pilot deployment restores the old merging.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for env-var behavior-changed
